name: nebula
description: Turn PDFs, scans, Office files and images into clean, structured markdown with Nebula OCR.

interface.longDescription: Nebula converts documents into clean, structured markdown you can read, search and pull data from inside ChatGPT. Give it a PDF, a scanned page, an Office file (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), an HTML page or a plain-text file and ask it to convert the document with Nebula. It handles scans and complex tables and returns markdown with tables, headings and page structure intact. Built for Japanese and English business documents. Attach a document and say "convert this with Nebula", or paste a link. Sign in with a Nebula account at nebula.ur-ai.net. Setup and usage guide at nebula.ur-ai.net/api-docs?tab=mcp.
